flags.message: Hold petition: the QP states it presents the same question as No. 25-1383 (Indian Harbor v. Town of Vinton) and asks the Court to hold it. The forecast is therefore driven by Vinton's docket (response requested Jul 27 2026 after a waiver; two cert-stage amici; no redistribution or disposition as of Oct 4 2026), read from supremecourt.gov because the corpus does not track 25-1383 (no scotus/9025001383 case). The Aug 27 'Rescheduled' entry here tracks Vinton rather than signalling anything about this petition's own merits; resolution may take until mid-2027 if Vinton is granted.
